description: This file contains an integration test class for testing telemetry message sending and receiving using JMS in the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies that messages sent to a specific destination are received by a consumer, and manages connections to the messaging network and AMQP adapter.

classes.name: TelemetryJmsQoS1IT
classes.description: An integration test class for testing JMS telemetry message flow with QoS 1 in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the messaging network connection and registry client before all tests.

methods.name: printTestName
methods.description: Logs the name of each individual test before execution.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up message consumer and AMQP adapter connection after each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes the messaging network connection after all tests.

methods.name: testTelemetryUpload
methods.description: Main test method that verifies telemetry messages are correctly sent and received.

methods.name: givenATelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry consumer for the specified tenant.

methods.name: getAmqpAdapterConnection
methods.description: Establishes a new connection to the AMQP adapter.
